canonical_name: Rankine-Hugoniot condition for a one-dimensional scalar conservation law
canonical_statement: Let f : Real -> Real, let uL uR s : Real, and define u(t,x) to equal uL for x < s*t and uR for x > s*t. The discontinuity contributes no distributional defect to partial_t u + partial_x (f composed with u) if and only if s*(uR-uL) = f(uR)-f(uL).
domain_and_universes: f : Real -> Real; uL uR s : Real; scalar one-space-dimensional conservation law; Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: The two constant states are separated by the line x = s*t
Weak/distributional solution is interpreted using compactly supported smooth test functions
conclusion: The interface defect vanishes iff s * (uR - uL) = f uR - f uL
degenerate_cases: uL = uR is included and makes the algebraic condition automatic; s = 0 is included; values on x = s*t are measure-zero and must not affect the weak formulation.

alternate_encodings.target: f uR - s*uR = f uL - s*uL
multicomponent and multidimensional normal-flux jump conditions
alternate_encodings.relationship: generalization, not interchangeable with this root
